referenceSources.description:
A striking red Citroën ZX rally car is showcased in a garage setting, its body adorned with bold TOTAL and Michelin branding. The front end features a set of four auxiliary rally lights mounted on the hood, ready for night stages, while the white multi-spoke wheels and roof spoiler enhance its competitive appearance. The windshield carries the name “Enjolras,” and the rear side panel is emblazoned with the Citroën logo in large white letters.

This image appears on a specialized rally body kits website offering a comprehensive catalog of Citroën ZX competition parts. The site lists reference codes, descriptions, and prices for components such as carbon fiber hoods, bumpers, fenders, door panels, lamp pods, and polycarbonate windows. It also includes FIA homologation details for the ZX Kit Car, emphasizing the requirement for original stamped forms. Additional accessories like driving and fog lights, mounting hardware, and connectors are itemized with their specifications and costs, catering to rally enthusiasts and builders.
